passages.note: Bill details page lists King as a co-author of HB 1041, which bars males based on biological sex at birth from girls' teams.
passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Chris Jeter, Rep. Joanna King, Rep. Robert Heaton.

passages.provision_quote: A male, based on a student's biological sex at birth in accordance with the student's genetics and reproductive biology, may not participate on an athletic team or sport designated under this section as being a female, women's, or girls' athletic team or sport.
passages.note: Enrolled Act text bars participation on girls' teams based on biological sex at birth, matching rung 4 and excluding a full ban (rung 5).
Roll Call 402 records King voting Yea to override the governor's veto of HEA 1041.
passages.tally_quote: Yea 67 Participation in school sports. (2022) Nay 28 Excused 5 Not Voting 0

rows.reasoning: King co-authored HB 1041 (2022) and voted Yea on Roll Call 402 to override the governor's veto of the enrolled act, which bars a male based on biological sex at birth from participating on a girls' team; this matches 'require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth' and excludes a complete ban from all organized sports.
